g.text: Master code opens Master Mode. Reset and Emergency Stop are menu options; no physical reset button is included.
Emergency Stop halts actuators, effects, and both speakers. Keypad scanning and LCD updates continue.
Both speakers play background music during normal operation. SD music is preferred; audio storage / transport remain TBD.
